params.name: dataset_id
params.description: ID of a Roboflow dataset corresponding to the model to use for inference OR workspace ID

params.name: version_id
params.description: ID of a Roboflow dataset version corresponding to the model to use for inference OR model ID

params.name: api_key
params.description: Roboflow API Key that will be passed to the model during initialization for artifact retrieval

params.name: confidence
params.description: The confidence threshold used to filter out predictions. Pass a float in [0, 1], or "best" to use F1-optimal thresholds from model evaluation, or "default" to use the model's built-in default.

params.name: keypoint_confidence
params.description: The confidence threshold used to filter out keypoints that are not visible based on model confidence

params.name: format
params.description: One of 'json' or 'image'. If 'json' prediction data is return as a JSON string. If 'image' prediction data is visualized and overlayed on the original input image.

params.name: image
params.description: The publically accessible URL of an image to use for inference.

params.name: image_type
params.description: One of base64 or numpy. Note, numpy input is not supported for Roboflow Hosted Inference.

params.name: labels
params.description: If true, labels will be include in any inference visualization.

params.name: mask_decode_mode
params.description: One of 'accurate' or 'fast'. If 'accurate' the mask will be decoded using the original image size. If 'fast' the mask will be decoded using the original mask size. 'accurate' is slower but more accurate.

params.name: tradeoff_factor
params.description: The amount to tradeoff between 0='fast' and 1='accurate'

params.name: max_detections
params.description: The maximum number of detections to return. This is used to limit the number of predictions returned by the model. The model may return more predictions than this number, but only the top `max_detections` predictions will be returned.

params.name: overlap
params.description: The IoU threhsold that must be met for a box pair to be considered duplicate during NMS

params.name: stroke
params.description: The stroke width used when visualizing predictions

params.name: disable_preproc_auto_orient
params.description: If true, disables automatic image orientation

params.name: disable_preproc_contrast
params.description: If true, disables automatic contrast adjustment

params.name: disable_preproc_grayscale
params.description: If true, disables automatic grayscale conversion

params.name: disable_preproc_static_crop
params.description: If true, disables automatic static crop

params.name: disable_active_learning
params.description: If true, the predictions will be prevented from registration by Active Learning (if the functionality is enabled)

params.name: active_learning_target_dataset
params.description: Parameter to be used when Active Learning data registration should happen against different dataset than the one pointed by model_id

params.name: source
params.description: The source of the inference request

params.name: source_info
params.description: The detailed source information of the inference request

params.name: response_mask_format
params.description: The format of the prediction mask - polygon (default) or rle - applicable for instance segmentation models.
